pr_title: planner: fix "can't find column" when projection wrongly added above table reader after agg pushed down
pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #23736 

Problem Summary:

A projection was added between the partial agg and the final agg, and the schema between them was broken.

### What is changed and how it works?


Not to add the extra projection if the agg was pushed down.

### Related changes

- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Integration test


### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- no release note.

issue_context.title: Can't find column in schema Column: [Column#10] Unique key: [] when using stream_agg()  hint
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
```sql
create table t0(a int, b int, c int as (a + b) virtual, unique index (c) invisible);
create table t1(a int, b int, c int as (a + b) virtual);
insert into t0(a, b) values (12, -1), (8, 7);
insert into t1(a, b) values (12, -1), (8, 7);
select /*+ stream_agg() */ count(1) from t0 where c > 10 and b < 2;
select /*+ stream_agg() */ count(1) from t1 where c > 10 and b < 2;
```
<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```sql
mysql > select /*+ stream_agg() */ count(1) from t0 where c > 10 and b < 2;
+----------+
| count(1) |
+----------+
| 1        |
+----------+

1 row in set
Time: 0.133s
mysql > select /*+ stream_agg() */ count(1) from t1 where c > 10 and b < 2;
+----------+
| count(1) |
+----------+
| 1        |
+----------+

```
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```sql
mysql > select /*+ stream_agg() */ count(1) from t0 where c > 10 and b < 2;
(1105, "Can't find column hchwang.t0.b in schema Column: [Column#6] Unique key: []")
mysql > select /*+ stream_agg() */ count(1) from t1 where c > 10 and b < 2;
(1105, "Can't find column hchwang.t1.b in schema Column: [Column#6] Unique key: []")
```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
master: f43f750fb551f2f

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

review_comments:
Nice catch!

An example wrong query plan:
```
+------------------------------+---------+-----------+---------------+------------------------------------+
| id                           | estRows | task      | access object | operator info                      |
+------------------------------+---------+-----------+---------------+------------------------------------+
| HashAgg_13                   | 1.00    | root      |               | funcs:count(Column#6)->Column#5    |
| └─TableReader_14             | 1.00    | root      |               | data:HashAgg_6                     |
|   └─HashAgg_6                | 1.00    | cop[tikv] |               | funcs:count(1)->Column#6           |
|     └─Selection_12           | 0.11    | cop[tikv] |               | lt(test.t0.b, 2), lt(test.t0.b, 2) |
|       └─TableFullScan_11     | 1.00    | cop[tikv] | table:t0      | keep order:false, stats:pseudo     |
+------------------------------+---------+-----------+---------------+------------------------------------+
```

The reason is that in `getOriginalPhysicalTableScan()`, the PhysicalTableScan.filterCondition and path.TableFilters share the same underlying array.

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/91bcb21b57bd07f77987e144dc63f1e8efc793ce/planner/core/find_best_task.go#L1744-L1757

When it is modified in addPushedDownSelection() => SplitSelCondsWithVirtualColumn()
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/cd5b91fa0388091d720e8554161b983ee980eab0/planner/core/find_best_task.go#L1527

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/91bcb21b57bd07f77987e144dc63f1e8efc793ce/planner/core/find_best_task.go#L1728-L1729

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/91bcb21b57bd07f77987e144dc63f1e8efc793ce/planner/core/find_best_task.go#L1184-L1193

Actually, what L1189 doing is changing the underlying array from [c > 10, b < 2] into [b < 2, b < 2]

The original AccessPath.TableFilters is also modified, all the plans generated after this are all wrong.
If we don't add the selection here, where should we add it?
Sorry...I didn't get it. This change should only affect the PhysicalProjection.
